findings.app 10038-1: No Content-Security-Policy: its connect-src is the install's API origin, which config.js supplies at runtime, so the image's nginx cannot spell it. #679.
findings.app 90003: The Google Fonts stylesheet has no integrity attribute because Google serves it per browser; the fonts leave with #438.
findings.app 90004-2: No Cross-Origin-Embedder-Policy: nothing here needs cross-origin isolation, and require-corp would refuse the Google Fonts (#438).
findings.docs 10021: Swagger UI's nginx sets no nosniff. The host serves public specifications with no session or cookie.
findings.docs 10055-13: Swagger UI's image sends a CSP of frame-ancestors 'none' alone, to refuse framing; ZAP reads the missing directives as wildcards. Public documentation with no session.
findings.docs 10055-4: As docs 10055-13: the frame-ancestors-only policy, read as a wildcard.
findings.docs 10055-5: As docs 10055-13: the frame-ancestors-only policy, read as allowing inline script.
findings.docs 10055-6: As docs 10055-13: the frame-ancestors-only policy, read as allowing inline style.
findings.docs 10063-1: Swagger UI's nginx sets no Permissions-Policy. The host serves public specifications with no session or cookie.
findings.docs 10096: False positive: a number in swagger-ui-standalone-preset.js that ZAP reads as a Unix time.
findings.docs 90004-1: Swagger UI's nginx sets no Cross-Origin-Resource-Policy. The host serves public specifications with no session or cookie.
findings.docs 90004-2: No Cross-Origin-Embedder-Policy: public documentation needs no cross-origin isolation.
findings.docs 90004-3: No Cross-Origin-Opener-Policy from Swagger UI's nginx. The host holds no session for an opener to reach.

findings.grafana 10021: Grafana omits nosniff only on static images and browserconfig.xml under /public; its pages carry it, and it has no setting for the rest.
findings.grafana 10038-1: Grafana's content_security_policy is off by default and needs testing against the provisioned dashboards and plugins first. #679.
findings.grafana 10063-1: Grafana writes its own response headers and has no setting for Permissions-Policy.
findings.grafana 10096: False positive: a number in Grafana's login page that ZAP reads as a Unix time.
findings.grafana 90004-1: Grafana writes its own response headers and has no setting for Cross-Origin-Resource-Policy.
findings.grafana 90004-2: Grafana writes its own response headers and has no setting for Cross-Origin-Embedder-Policy; nothing needs cross-origin isolation.
findings.grafana 90004-3: Grafana writes its own response headers and has no setting for Cross-Origin-Opener-Policy.
findings.i3x 10036-2: False positive: the header is aber-i3x, the service's name, and ZAP reads the 3 in i3x as a version. GET /info carries serverVersion.
findings.nodered 10038-1: The editor is built on inline scripts and handlers, so its policy needs a report-only run first. #679.
findings.nodered 90004-2: No Cross-Origin-Embedder-Policy: the editor needs no cross-origin isolation.
